subject: Rebate allocation proposal for marketplace listing renewal
messages:
From: Lucy Davenport <lucy.davenport@cloudpartners.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: AWS Partner Ops <partner_ops@aws-marketplace.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Proposal: rebate allocation rebalancing for Redwood listing renewal

Hi Vanessa,

Following our renewal cadence for Redwood's AWS Marketplace listing, we ran the program-level reconciliation and are proposing a small rebalance of listing fee credits for Q3 onward. Attached is the AWS_fee_schedule_Q2_2027.pdf (summary) — key ask below:

- Move 40% of the co-sell/listing credit from the EMEA bucket into the US bucket for the next 12 months (pilot).
- In return, CloudPartners would increase featured placement credits in two AWS marketing sweeps in Q3/Q4.

We believe this preserves your overall rebate while improving net spend alignment to your customer footprint. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a regional reallocation in place of raw credit increases? If so, we can draft an amendment and route to DocuSign.

Proposed next step: 15-minute sync (Mon/Tue) to align legal/finance redlines.

Best,
Lucy Davenport
Sr. Partner Manager
CloudPartners Inc.
[Attachment: AWS_fee_schedule_Q2_2027.pdf (PDF)]
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucy Davenport <lucy.davenport@cloudpartners.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 10:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: rebate allocation rebalancing for Redwood listing renewal

Thanks, Lucy — appreciate the write-up and the PDF. Quick clarifying questions before we schedule: 

- What is the modeled net USD impact to Redwood on a trailing 12-month basis (we need this for finance sign-off)?
- Can CloudPartners guarantee the two marketing placements will be executed in the quarter windows you noted? We need execution SLAs.

Marcus, Karthik — looping you both in. Marcus, can you run a quick scenario in the attached rvw_fee_model.xlsx and confirm the P&L delta (headroom/shortfall) if we accept a 40% shift? Karthik, assuming delta is within 6% of our current rebate, are you comfortable approving a reallocation (finance approval + PO amendment)?

If it looks viable we'll ask CloudPartners for an amendment draft and a DocuSign link. Happy to do a 15-min sync on Monday at 9:30 PT if that works for Lucy.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rvw_fee_model.xlsx (Excel)]

On Sat, Apr 10, 2027 at 09:12 AM Lucy Davenport <lucy.davenport@cloudpartners.com> wrote:
> Following our renewal cadence for Redwood's AWS Marketplace listing, we ran the program-level reconciliation and are proposing a small rebalance...
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:01:15 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: rebate allocation rebalancing for Redwood listing renewal

Forwarding Lucy's note with a quick read from finance ops.

Vanessa / Karthik — ran the numbers in rvw_fee_model.xlsx (tab: scenarios). Short summary:

- Baseline (no change): net rebate $1,080,000 annualized.
- 40% EMEA->US reallocation (CloudPartners proposal): modeled net rebate $1,042,000 (3.5% reduction) but with increased GTM credits that we estimate produce $75-110k incremental pipeline influence in US given our past scoring.

Recommendation: Accept a two-tier approach — 30% reallocation now with a conditional 10% bump if both Q3 and Q4 placements execute as committed. That splits risk and preserves headline rebate.

Action items I suggest before we say yes:
- Get placement execution SLAs and sample creative schedule from CloudPartners.
- Insert a clawback clause into the amendment that returns the 10% if placements aren't delivered in the windows.
- Legal to review amendment for wording.

I'll ping AWS Partner Ops contact if we need marketplace-side support for the amendment routing.

—Marcus
Finance Ops (on rotation)

> On Sat, Apr 10, 2027 at 10:03 AM vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> > Thanks, Lucy — appreciate the write-up and the PDF...
From: Lucy Davenport <lucy.davenport@cloudpartners.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: AWS Partner Ops <partner_ops@aws-marketplace.com>, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:22:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: rebate allocation rebalancing for Redwood listing renewal

Vanessa / Marcus / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick review and Marcus' recommendation — happy to accept the two-tier mechanic. I attached a short draft amendment (proposal_amendment_draft.docx) with:

- 30% reallocation effective immediately, 10% contingent on both Q3/Q4 placements.
- Placement execution windows and delivery definition.
- Clawback language tied to campaign proof-of-performance.

DocuSign link will be ready once you confirm legal/finance redlines; HubSpot deal updated here: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DP-9876.

We can do Mon 9:30 PT. If you want me to include the AWS Partner Ops specialist on that call to speed marketplace routing, say the word.

Best,
Lucy
Sr. Partner Manager
CloudPartners Inc.
[Attachment: proposal_amendment_draft.docx (Word)]
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:05:02 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposal: rebate allocation rebalancing for Redwood listing renewal

Thanks team — reviewed Marcus' calc and Lucy's draft. Approve moving forward with the two-tier approach (30% now + 10% contingent). Please:

1) Vanessa — confirm Mon 9:30 PT and ask Lucy to include AWS Partner Ops rep.
2) Marcus — prepare a short PO amendment and updated forecast for finance (I'll sign off once PO is ready).
3) Legal — I'll loop them after Vanessa confirms the meeting so they can review the draft amendment before DocuSign.

Once the amendment includes the clawback language and delivery definition, I will approve.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
